Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{kind: "uri", mime_type: "text/plain", uri: "https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"text\",\"max_characters\":300,\"overlap\":40,\"trim\":true}}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).chunks)
```
